rule: Initial 2026 law: general IS28%; microfinance and private education organised as a company25%; mines/quarries and property operations28%; foreign legal persons33%. Hydrocarbon exploration, production, storage and transport use their contract rate, no lower than ordinary law. Round taxable profit down to the lower XAF1,000.
quote_fr: Le taux général de l’impôt sur les sociétés est fixé à 28%.

rule: Companies including single-member SA, SAS and SARL are within IS by form; public entities and other bodies conducting taxable commercial activities are within its activity scope. Partnership options and statutory exemptions must be considered separately.
quote_fr: y compris lorsqu’elles sont unipersonnelles

rule: Determine taxable net profit from all taxable receipts less allowable costs using OHADA accounting or applicable regulated-sector rules. Accounts ordinarily close31December; tax is assessed on the preceding financial year.
quote_fr: Les contribuables sont tenus d’arrêter chaque année leurs comptes à la date du 31 décembre

rule: Costs must belong to the year, serve the business, be real and supported, reduce net assets, and not support exempt receipts or be legally excluded/abnormal management. Domestic supplier invoices require the NIU and SFEC. Cash payments of XAF200,000 or more fail the deduction condition. Do not import VAT's strictly-greater-than boundary into IS.
quote_fr: ne pas être payées en espèces pour un montant supérieur ou égal à 200 000 FCFA

rule: IS itself is not deductible; taxes borne by the enterprise and assessed during the year can be deductible. Fines, confiscations and penalties are excluded. Later refunds of deductible taxes enter receipts.
quote_fr: à l’exclusion de l’impôt sur les sociétés

rule: Interest must meet the ordinary conditions and market pricing. Related-shareholder/group interest additionally requires fully paid capital and is limited by BEAC tender rate plus3points. Total annual net interest is capped at20% of OHADA gross operating surplus attributable to non-exempt activity, with disallowed interest carryforward up to5years subject to the same conditions. The cap excludes qualifying finance/insurance operating-charge interest. No live BEAC rate is supplied.
quote_fr: limité à un niveau fixé à 20% de l’excédent brut d’exploitation
additional_quotes_fr: dans la limite de cinq (5) ans

rule: Ordinary losses carry forward through the fifth year after the loss year. Depreciation booked during losses is treated as ordinary losses. Losses from IS-exempt years cannot carry forward.
quote_fr: jusqu’au cinquième exercice qui suit l’exercice déficitaire
additional_quotes_fr: Les amortissements régulièrement comptabilisés en période déficitaire

rule: Minimum perception is1% of total operating, financial and non-ordinary receipts, excluding receipts already subject to final withholding. Compare this minimum with ordinary IS; do not use only sales turnover or reinstate the old unsupported fixed minimum floors.
quote_fr: Le taux du minimum de perception est fixé à 1%.

rule: Declare the current-year minimum by15March using preceding-year/last-closed-year receipts provisionally. Pay four minimum-tax instalments by15March,15June,15September and15December. The minimum credits against same-year IS, but remains with Treasury where ordinary liability is lower or nil.
quote_fr: au plus tard le 15 mars, le 15 juin, le 15 septembre et le 15 décembre
additional_quotes_fr: au plus tard le 15 mars de la même année

rule: CGI86F requires the profit/loss return within4months of year-end;86G requires the balance on delivery. The official 2026 ACPCE calendar instead states15May for IS/DSF. These are conflicting sources: retain the statutory wording here, flag the administrative date, and stop short of an operative2026 filing instruction until reconciled.
quote_fr: dans les quatre mois de la clôture de l’exercice

rule: Submit the existence declaration within15days of beginning operations. The annual DSF follows the prescribed model, with financial statements, tax reconciliation and identification schedules. CGI131 specifies3complete sets plus electronic statements. CGI130 requires real-regime electronic declaration/payment and appropriate accountant certification where no statutory auditor exists. Portal, current form version and field numbers remain unconfirmed.
quote_fr: dans les quinze jours du début de leurs opérations

rule: Failure to pay the minimum attracts50% of the unpaid minimum under86C(8). This is not a universal rate for every late tax.
quote_fr: une pénalité de 50% du montant dû

rule: Non-compliance with the real-regime electronic declaration/payment obligation attracts10% of the amount to declare. This does not establish an all-purpose annual-return penalty.
quote_fr: une pénalité de 10% du montant à déclarer

rule: Where a taxpayer corrects an underpayment before an administration claim or information request,374ter prescribes0.5% per day capped at20% of principal and no penalty in that particular case. It is not a general late-payment interest rate.
quote_fr: 0,5% par jour de retard sans excéder 20%

rule: The initial2026 text replaces the former global IRPP chapters with separate business-profit(IBA), investment-income(IRCM), property-income(IRF) and salary/pension(ITS) chapters. Classify each receipt before computing; the old four-band global IRPP computation is not carried forward.
quote_fr: CHAPITRE 2 : IMPOTS SUR LES REVENUS

rule: IBA is30% of profit rounded down to XAF1,000, subject to a1.5% minimum on total operating, financial and non-ordinary receipts. The minimum follows the IS minimum rules. Do not use the salary scale for an ordinary sole-trader profit.
quote_fr: Le taux de l’impôt sur les bénéfices d’affaires est fixé à 30%.

rule: IBA generally follows IS base rules, but depreciation is straight-line only, doubtful-debt provisions are not deductible, losses run only through the third following year, and the investment credit3A is unavailable. Personal drawings/costs, interest on own capital and self-rent are not deductible; split mixed expenses and limit representation expenses to50%.
quote_fr: le report déficitaire ne peut s’étendre que jusqu’au troisième exercice
additional_quotes_fr: les provisions pour créances douteuses ne sont pas déductibles
ne peuvent pas bénéficier du crédit

rule: The forfait concerns taxpayers not exceeding the VAT threshold, but excludes regulated professions, bakers, works contractors, hardware operators, wholesalers and importers. VAT election immediately leads to ordinary IBA; decline below the threshold needs2successive years before returning to forfait. The forfait ceases after the year of excess. Exact current threshold and5%/8% computation chain remain on hold.
quote_fr: sont exclus du régime du forfait

rule: CGI93B recognises habitual residence from an available owned/usufruct home, a rental lasting at least1continuous year, or principal stay, plus listed government/assignment/retained-interest cases. Absence continuously exceeding24months loses residence. Non-residents are taxed on Congo-source income. Foreign branch directors have a residence presumption; treaties and government-posting provisions affect the answer. This is not a universal183-day test.
quote_fr: une absence continue d’une durée supérieure à vingt-quatre mois
additional_quotes_fr: les personnes physiques qui sont désignées

rule: IRCM is15%, with35% for hidden income. Distributed profits, interest, securities gains and deemed PE distributions have different bases and timing. Normal interest is not generally assumed tax-free merely because the recipient is resident.
quote_fr: Ce taux est fixé à 35% pour les revenus occultes.

rule: IRCM is due where income is paid by an enterprise operated in Congo or the recipient is domiciled/resident in Congo. For dividends the tax event is the distribution decision, with exigibility at payment and no later than3months after that decision. The normal dividend base is gross dividends.
quote_fr: au plus tard trois (3) mois après la décision de leur distribution

rule: For property income outside an IS enterprise, IRF is9% on gross rents and10% on property gains. Congo property is within source scope regardless of recipient residence; a resident can also have foreign property in scope. The gain base permits documented acquisition expenses and qualifying construction/improvement costs.
quote_fr: 9% pour les revenus locatifs

rule: Exemptions cover free occupation by direct ancestors/descendants, disposal gains on a principal residence held at least5years, and State/local-authority property income. Do not extend the principal-residence exemption to investment property.
quote_fr: la résidence principale détenue par le cédant depuis au moins 5 ans

rule: Listed IS-business, IBA-business and public tenants withhold landlord IRF;113A gives15March or3months after taking a new lease. Individuals receiving rent from other tenants declare by15May, with balance dates15May,20August and15November. Deduct properly evidenced property-tax advances. Property gains are declared/paid within3months after the gain; duties sit with the contract registry or land-conservation office respectively.
quote_fr: au plus tard le 15 mai, le 20 août et le 15 novembre
additional_quotes_fr: dans les trois mois de l’entrée en jouissance du bail
au plus tard dans les trois (3) mois

rule: Listed tenants failing to withhold are jointly responsible for unpaid tax and an additional fine equal to principal;113A extends the stated default conditions to gain declaration/payment. This is not the general penalty for every individual return.
quote_fr: une amende égale au montant des droits en principal

rule: ITS covers employment, directors' remuneration not expressly assigned to IRCM, pensions and annuities.114A expressly exempts retirement pensions and listed benefits including qualifying transport, social-plan termination, unemployment, death capital and specified compensation. Test the precise exemption conditions before excluding a payment.
quote_fr: les pensions de retraite

rule: ITS domicile tests are a permanent available home, otherwise centre of vital interests, and State employees posted abroad. A domiciled recipient has employment income in scope even for work/employer abroad. For non-domiciled recipients114D(1)(b) describes work exercised in Congo with an employer domiciled/established there. Treaty and special source facts need separate review.
quote_fr: le centre de leurs intérêts vitaux

item: Salary benefits and deductible pension amount
rule: Start with gross cash and benefits. Benefits use actual value, or statutory defaults: housing20% of salary capped for social security; domestic staff/security7%, utilities5%, telephone2%, car3%, food20% of gross. The reference base deducts specified pension/mandatory-social amounts. Employer mutual premiums are not taxable if benefiting all employees. ITS then allows20% deduction after the employee retirement contribution. Social contribution rates/ceilings are not established here.
quote_fr: une déduction de 20% est appliquée au montant net

rule: Round net taxable salary down to XAF1,000 before dividing by parts; tax the quotient and multiply by parts. Basic parts: single/divorced/widowed without dependants1; married without dependants2; single/divorced with1child2; married/widowed with1child2.5; each additional child adds0.5, maximum6.5. Separate-employed spouses are each treated as married, children assigned to husband absent express exception. A childless widow(er) is treated as married for2years following death. Special116C situations remain a referral.
quote_fr: jusqu’à un maximum de 6,5 parts

rule: Dependants need no separately assessed income: legitimate/recognised/adopted children under21, disabled children, students up to25 with evidence, plus qualifying foster/protected children(the latter limited to2).116E requires the stated court decision for mothers claiming children. Use1January family facts except marriage/increased dependants during the year uses31December or death date. Do not infer shares from a payslip alone.
quote_fr: reportée à 25 ans pour les enfants poursuivant leurs études

rule: Initial 2026 ITS per part: XAF1,200 fixed for the fraction0–615,000;10% on615,001–1,500,000;15% on1,500,001–3,500,000;20% on3,500,001–5,000,000;30% thereafter. The first item is a fixed franc amount, not1,200% or1%. Where gross salary is below the legally fixed SMIG,116G(2) prescribes annual minimum XAF1,200. The current SMIG amount is not supplied.
quote_fr: 1 200 F CFA pour la fraction comprise entre 0 et 615 000

rule: ITS is collected by monthly employer withholding. It is final where there is only1salary source; with multiple salary sources the recipient must submit an annual salary declaration for unified taxation. Foreign-source income is declared/paid by the recipient under the Code.116I(2) directs2026 calculations under114–116H; the DAS3 transition paragraph explicitly concerns2025. Do not convert it into a universal2026 new deadline.
quote_fr: si le bénéficiaire dispose d’une seule source de traitements et salaires

rule: Forfait taxpayers keep OHADA minimal-cash records, chronological purchase/expense and sales/service registers, monthly declarations, applicable withholding and specified annual statements; registers require quarterly endorsement.98 describes the annual form294, first-year estimation and15-day start-of-activity register formalities.99 requires supplier lists by15th of the month following each quarter.
quote_fr: la liste de ses fournisseurs ou de ses sources d’approvisionnement

rule: 98(5) attaches assessment ex officio and XAF100,000 to the stated declaration/register/document defaults.99 attaches XAF500,000 to failure to provide the quarterly supplier list. Scope these separately and do not treat both as universal late-return fines.
quote_fr: une amende de 500 000 FCFA

rule: For enterprises dependent on/controlling foreign enterprises, including common foreign control, profits indirectly shifted through purchase/sale prices or other means are restored to Congo results. Dependency need not be shown for transfers to an enterprise in a privileged-tax foreign territory. Lack of documents permits assessment from available information; comparable enterprises and functional/comparability/industry analyses are relevant. The documentation threshold is not a substantive exemption.
quote_fr: La condition de dépendance ou de contrôle n’est pas exigée

rule: Congo-established legal persons with annual tax-exclusive turnover OR gross balance-sheet assets at least XAF500,000,000 keep documentation for transactions of any kind with foreign related legal entities. Apply the OR test at equality, not turnover alone.
quote_fr: supérieur ou égal à 500.000.000 FCFA

rule: Documentation includes group activities and changes, legal/operational structure and controlled counterparties, functions/risks affecting results, principal intangibles connected to the enterprise and group pricing policy.
quote_fr: une description générale de la politique de prix de transfert du groupe

rule: Include local activity/changes; nature and amount of flows including royalties; cost-sharing agreements, relevant APAs/rulings; FAR and justified selected methods; comparables where appropriate; principal method and yearly changes.81II also calls out transactions whose aggregate by nature exceeds XAF50,000,000. That detail line does not replace the500million entity test.
quote_fr: lorsque le montant agrégé par nature des transactions excède 50 000 000 de FCFA

rule: Documentation does not replace underlying transaction evidence and must be available when the accounting audit starts. Keeping an unfinished file until a later information request does not satisfy that trigger.
quote_fr: à la date d’engagement de la vérification de comptabilité

rule: Entities within81I spontaneously transmit the prescribed annual declaration accompanying TP documentation within6months after the annual results return deadline. The light and full TP declarations are accompanied by the stated country-by-country declaration. Do not invent a separate EUR750million threshold; no such threshold appears in the cited81 wording. Because the results-return deadline conflicts across official sources, no fixed calendar CbC date is certified here.
quote_fr: dans un délai de six (6) mois
additional_quotes_fr: suivant la date limite de dépôt de la déclaration de résultat

rule: Country-by-country information covers jurisdiction aggregates for turnover, pretax profit/loss, taxes paid/due, capital, retained earnings with years, staff and tangible assets excluding cash/equivalents. Identify group entities having controlled transactions with the local entity, tax residence and principal business activities. Do not treat this as only a related-party invoice list.
quote_fr: les informations agrégées sur le chiffre d’affaires

rule: 81IV(2) provides XAF5,000,000 after an unanswered8-day formal demand for the stated documentation/declaration defaults, subject to other declaration sanctions. Missing full documentation at audit commencement has a separate XAF25,000,000 fine. Late CbC or accompanying TP declaration has XAF5,000,000. Do not mechanically add overlapping amounts without classifying the actual defaults.
quote_fr: une amende de 25 000 000 de FCFA

rule: Failure to provide CbC after an8-day formal demand calls the period's controlled prices into question. Foreign charges outside arm's-length conditions or the described policy are added back to the Congo enterprise's result.
quote_fr: la remise en cause des prix de transfert pratiqués

rule: 82 allows a precise request on foreign relationships, pricing/method justification, activities and tax treatment. Initial response time cannot be less than1month; reasoned extension may bring the total to no more than3months. An insufficient answer can receive a further30-day completion demand specifying missing items and sanctions.
quote_fr: ne peut être inférieur à un mois

rule: 85 recognises CUP, cost plus, resale price, TNMM and profit split. The selected method must be justified, coherent with functions and assumed risks, and deliver arm's-length remuneration. The fifth method and selection sentence were visually read on Gazette p46 because the text layer omitted them. No automatic hierarchy or mandatory median rule is supplied.
quote_fr: Il existe cinq (5) méthodes de fixation du prix de pleine concurrence

rule: 84 permits bilateral agreements via treaty competent authorities and unilateral Congo agreements. A unilateral agreement is transaction/activity/function/product-specific; APAs last at most3years, renewable under conditions, and conclusion requires XAF10,000,000. Payment/request alone is not approval.
quote_fr: une durée maximale de trois ans (3) renouvelable

rule: Where foreign information was requested within the original reassessment period,83 permits correction until the end of the year after the response, but no later than the end of the sixth year following the tax year. This is conditional, not a universal6-year audit period.
quote_fr: la fin de la sixième année qui suit celle au titre de laquelle l’imposition est due

rule: Enterprises registered in Congo or effectively managed there are resident enterprises; non-residents with a Congo PE are operated in Congo. Nonresident PE profit attribution includes the PE, same/similar goods sales and same/similar industrial/commercial activities in Congo under7. Do not assume worldwide exemption or only invoiced branch profits.
quote_fr: celles qui y sont immatriculées ou qui y ont leur lieu de direction effective

rule: 4A lists fixed places and deems a construction/assembly/installation/supervision project a PE when lasting more than3months. Services through personnel for the same/connected project create a PE when exceeding183days in any12months. Equality alone does not satisfy these specific duration limbs, but a fixed place or agency can independently create a PE.
quote_fr: plus de cent quatre-vingt-trois (183) jours

rule: Storage/exhibition, processing by another enterprise, purchasing/information and other listed activities need the relevant preparatory/auxiliary limitation. Anti-fragmentation denies the exception for linked complementary business functions, an existing PE or a combined non-auxiliary activity. Do not split one coherent business across sites to claim a warehouse exemption.
quote_fr: ne revêt pas un caractère préparatoire ou auxiliaire

rule: Habitual contract conclusion/principal negotiating role or habitual stock delivery can create an agency PE. Nonresident insurers have the stated premium/risk rule except reinsurance. An ordinary independent agent can fall outside these limbs; near-exclusive activity for closely linked enterprises prevents independence. Control alone does not create a PE.4A(8)–(9) define close links, including more-than50% tests, but other actual control is relevant.
quote_fr: ne suffit pas, en lui-même

rule: Subject to applicable treaties,86D imposes20% IS withholding on payments by a resident company or for a nonresident company's PE for services rendered by nonresidents or royalties paid to them. Royalties include rights, equipment, know-how and software acquisition/rental as stated. Classify actual contracts first; do not apply the old miscellaneous reduced-rate list by default.
quote_fr: au taux de 20%.
additional_quotes_fr: pour l’acquisition ou la location de logiciels

rule: 11 brings foreign PE results belonging to a CEMAC company and foreign dividends, interest, royalties and service fees of an enterprise operated in Congo into the stated tax base. Double tax can be relieved by foreign-tax deduction or a credit limited to Congo tax on the same income, subject to actual entitlement. Foreign PE losses are restricted to later PE profits within5years. Do not use both relief routes for the same amount.
quote_fr: dans la limite de l’impôt qui aurait été dû

rule: 92 concerns foreign legal entities whose intermittent/precarious activities do not permit the ordinary86C–F regime.92A fixes22% of qualifying tax-exclusive Congo turnover as deemed profit and92C points to86A, whose foreign-person rate is33%. Thus7.26% is the derived IS alone, not a universal service withholding rate or all-in burden. Mobilisation, reimbursed supplies and chain subcontract exclusions have cumulative conditions not certified in this short computation.
quote_fr: Ce pourcentage forfaitaire est fixé à 22 %

rule: 92 requires existence declaration, temporary operating authority and amendments; service declaration/payment by15th of the second month following service execution, and liquidation by cessation before mobilised people/equipment depart.92D requires a supplier-by-supplier statement naming contract, address, tax and billing month/amount. This is distinct from ordinary annual IS.
quote_fr: au plus tard le quinze (15) du deuxième mois

rule: 92E provides XAF100,000 per missing/incomplete invoice element; non/partial payment after8-day demand can incur100% of evaded principal; late payment before demand has1% per working day capped50%. The within-current-month deferral rule instead has XAF500,000 without that interest. Classification/overlap with374ter must be settled before using a penalty calculation.
quote_fr: sans excéder 50%

rule: 107 taxes nonresident direct/indirect gains on shares of a Congo-registered company where the person alone/with linked companies held at least10% of capital in the preceding365days. This test does not eliminate other property-rich gain rules. Use the income Guide for the IRCM base/rate;106 fusion relief has its own conditions.
quote_fr: au cours des 365 jours qui précèdent

rule: The ministry-hosted VAT law17 states ordinary18%; the2026 state-invoice rule7.2.4(d) repeats18% of the pretax price and centimes at5% of VAT. VAT36B says centimes are non-deductible. Thus an ordinary18%-rated transaction has VAT18% plus centimes0.9% of base, not23% of base. The complete later amendment chain is not closed.
quote_fr: fixée à 18% du prix total hors taxes

rule: The ACPCE2026 calendar lists5% reduced and0% VAT alongside18%. The2026 Finance Act replaces Annex3(exempt essential goods) and Annex5(reduced-rate ordinary-consumption goods). A listed tariff code and actual product must be matched before selecting relief; old forestry/SEZ and export eligibility are not fully verified here.

The compilation is a historical baseline, not a2026 consolidation.
quote_fr: La base d’imposition est arrondie au millier de francs CFA le plus proche.

rule: In the historical compilation10–11, delivery is the goods event and service performance is the service event; goods tax is generally exigible at delivery and services/works at receipts including advances, with a permitted debits basis. Imports are exigible at customs consumption declaration. Do not confuse invoice issue with every liability date; later changes remain to reconcile.

rule: The2026 amendment to VAT24 excludes input tax on cash-paid expenses whose amount EXCEEDS XAF200,000. At exactly200,000 this particular exclusion is not triggered; other input conditions still apply. The IS deduction boundary in CGI25 is different and excludes cash at equality.

Present the operations to it at least20days before work starts. Failure to conduct the required inventory cancels the VAT credit at31December.

rule: Employee ITS withholding follows114–116I, owned by the income Guide. Do not deduct an employer-only charge as if it were employee tax.
